page_title: How to get to Patagonia: flights, buses and roads
meta_description: How to reach Bariloche, El Calafate, Ushuaia, El Chaltén, Valdés Peninsula and Torres del Paine: airports, connections and border crossings.
hero_subtitle: Distances are huge: choosing how to travel wisely saves you days.
intro: Most travelers reach Patagonia by plane and combine flights with buses or rental cars between destinations. Some places are hundreds of kilometers apart, so it pays to plan a few bases and calculate transfers carefully.

destinations.name: Bariloche
destinations.from_buenos_aires: Direct flights of about 2 hours. By bus, the trip takes about a full day.
destinations.from_santiago: Overland from Osorno or Puerto Montt via the Cardenal Samoré Pass.
destinations.local_transport: City buses, tours and rental cars.
destinations.best_tip: In January and during ski season, book flights well in advance.

destinations.name: El Calafate
destinations.from_santiago: Overland from Puerto Natales, crossing the border.
destinations.local_transport: Buses, tours and rental cars. The airport is about 20 km from town.
destinations.best_tip: It's the base for Perito Moreno and the gateway to El Chaltén.

destinations.name: Ushuaia
destinations.from_santiago: Via Punta Arenas, by plane or on a long overland trip that crosses the Strait of Magellan by ferry.
destinations.best_tip: Wind can delay flights: avoid tight connections.

destinations.name: El Chaltén
destinations.nearest_airport: No airport: the nearest is El Calafate (FTE), about 220 km away
destinations.from_buenos_aires: Fly to El Calafate, then take a bus of about 3 hours.
destinations.local_transport: You get around on foot: many trails start in town.
destinations.best_tip: In high season, book the bus from El Calafate ahead of time.

destinations.name: Valdés Peninsula
destinations.from_buenos_aires: Flights to Trelew of about 2 hours, then around an hour by road to Puerto Madryn.
destinations.local_transport: Tours from Puerto Madryn or your own car. Puerto Pirámides is the starting point for whale watching.
destinations.best_tip: Roads inside the peninsula are gravel: drive carefully.

destinations.name: Torres del Paine
destinations.from_buenos_aires: Fly to El Calafate and cross overland to Puerto Natales, or fly via Santiago to Punta Arenas.
destinations.from_santiago: Flights to Punta Arenas, then about 3 hours by bus to Puerto Natales.
destinations.local_transport: Buses from Puerto Natales to the park.
destinations.best_tip: You need confirmed reservations to sleep inside the park.

pros: The fastest way to cover long distances
Direct flights from Buenos Aires to the main destinations
cons: Wind and weather can cause delays
transport_modes.tip: Fly into one city and out of another to avoid backtracking.

cons: Very long rides between some destinations
transport_modes.tip: For short legs, such as El Calafate–El Chaltén, it's the best choice.

pros: Freedom to stop at viewpoints and remote places
cons: Long distances with widely spaced gas stations
transport_modes.tip: If you plan to cross into Chile, ask the rental company for permission to leave the country.

border_crossings.name: Cardenal Samoré Pass
border_crossings.info: Connects Bariloche and Villa La Angostura with Osorno and Puerto Montt, Chile. It may close temporarily due to snow in winter.

border_crossings.name: Crossings between El Calafate and Puerto Natales
border_crossings.info: Used to combine El Calafate with Torres del Paine. Buses cover the full route.

border_crossings.name: Integración Austral Pass (Monte Aymond)
border_crossings.info: Connects Río Gallegos with Punta Arenas and is part of the overland route to Tierra del Fuego.

border_crossings.name: When entering Chile
border_crossings.info: Carry valid documents and don't bring fruit, vegetables, meat or dairy: Chile's agricultural control is strict.

booking_tips.title: Book early for summer
booking_tips.description: January and February see the highest demand for flights and buses.

booking_tips.title: Consider open-jaw routes
booking_tips.description: Arriving in one destination and leaving from another saves days of transfers.

booking_tips.title: Leave time between connections
booking_tips.description: Weather can delay flights and close border crossings.

booking_tips.title: Book buses between towns
booking_tips.description: In high season, the busiest routes fill up.
